Bit(s)  | Mask   | Description
--------|--------|-------------
0-2     | 0x0007 | Movement amount (0-7 pixels per frame)

5-7     | 0x00E0 | Movement speed/amount for Y-axis
8       | 0x0100 | Y direction: 0=up/subtract, 1=down/add
9       | 0x0200 | Enable flag for Y-axis movement

_**Agent (model copilot/gpt-4.1)**_

To get upwards movement using these bit flags, you need to:

- Set the Y-axis enable flag (bit 9, mask 0x0200)
- Set the Y direction to up (bit 8 = 0, so do not set 0x0100)
- Set the Y movement amount (bits 5-7, mask 0x00E0) to your desired speed (1–7)
- All other bits can be 0

For example, to move up by 3 pixels per frame:
- Bits 5-7: 3 (0b011) → 0x60
- Bit 9: 1 (enable Y) → 0x0200

So, the value is: 0x0200 | 0x60 = 0x0260

**Summary:**  
To move up by N pixels per frame, use:  
0x0200 | (N << 5)

For 3 pixels per frame upwards:  
**0x0260**

For 1 pixel per frame upwards:  
**0x0220**

Just change N (1–7) as needed.

_**Agent (model copilot/gpt-4.1)**_

To get upwards movement using this bit structure:

- Set Bit 9 (Y movement enable) to 1 → 0x0200
- Set Bits 5-7 (Y movement amount) to your desired value (N, 1–7), shifted left by 5: (N << 5)
- Bit 8 (Y direction): 0 for up (so do not set 0x0100)
- All other bits: 0

So, the hex value for "move up by N pixels per frame" is:
0x0200 | (N << 5)

Examples:
- Move up by 1: 0x0200 | 0x20 = 0x0220
- Move up by 3: 0x0200 | 0x60 = 0x0260

Just change N as needed.
